## `rundown`

```text
Usage: rundown [options] [command]

Runbook orchestration CLI

Options:
  -V, --version                 output the version number
  --no-color                    Disable colored output
  --schema                      Output JSON schema for the command's JSON output
  -h, --help                    display help for command

Policy options:
  --allow-run <commands>        Allow specific commands (comma-separated)
  --allow-read <paths>          Allow reading specific paths (comma-separated)
  --allow-write <paths>         Allow writing to specific paths
                                (comma-separated)
  --allow-env <vars>            Allow specific environment variables
                                (comma-separated)
  --allow-all                   Allow all operations (bypass policy)
  --deny-all                    Deny all operations
  --policy <file>               Path to policy configuration file
  --trust-js-policy             Trust executable JavaScript policy config files
  -y, --yes                     Skip confirmation prompts
  --non-interactive             Non-interactive mode (no prompts, CI-friendly)
  --sandbox                     Enable OS-level sandbox for file access
                                enforcement
  --no-sandbox                  Disable sandbox enforcement (trust mode); the
                                explicit opt-out when the sandbox is unavailable
  --sandbox-strict              Fail if sandbox is unavailable (default;
                                explicit affirmation of fail-closed)
  --helpers <paths>             Helper module paths to load (comma-separated,
                                relative to project root)

Commands:
  run [options] [file]          Start a runbook
  pass|yes [options]            Mark current step as passed (triggers PASS
                                transition)
  fail|no [options]             Mark current step as failed (triggers FAIL
                                transition)
  complete [options] [message]  Force early completion of a running runbook
                                (runbooks auto-complete on final step)
  goto [options] <step>         Jump to specific step (e.g., "3" or "3.1" for
                                substep)
  status [options]              Show run state (all runs, or one run with --run)
  stop [options] [message]      Abort a running runbook
  claim [options] <ticket>      Claim a delegated child by its Claim Ticket and
                                start it (prints its owner token)
  collect [options]             Collect the results of the run's current
                                delegated children
  retry [options]               Cancel a delegated child and reserve a fresh one
                                with a new claim ticket
  release [options] <child-id>  Abandon a delegated child you claimed but cannot
                                finish (collected as a fail)
  ls [options]                  List runbooks (runs by default, --all for
                                available)
  echo [options] [command...]   Echo command for runbook testing
  check [options] <file>        Check a runbook file for errors
  resolve [options] <file>      Resolve and validate runbook variables and data
                                sources
  prune [options]               Remove run state (does not delete runbook files)
  prompt [options] <content>    Output content wrapped in markdown fences
  scenario                      List, show, or run scenarios from a runbook
  scenario-suite                List, show, or run cases from a scenario suite
                                file
  artifact                      Inspect Rundown artifact aliases
  help [command]                display help for command
```

### `rundown run`

```text
Usage: rundown run [options] [file]

Start a runbook

Options:
  --prompted                   Prompted mode: show commands without
                               auto-executing
  --step <stepId>              Jump to a step after starting (requires
                               --prompted)
  --index <number>             FOR loop iteration to target (requires --step)
  --text                       Output execution events as human-readable text
  -h, --help                   display help for command

Input options:
  --input-file <path>          Load inputs from YAML file (repeatable) (default:
                               [])
  --input <key=value>          Set input (repeatable, omit =value to inherit
                               from env) (default: [])
  --input-json <key=json>      Set input with JSON value (repeatable) (default:
                               [])
  --artifacts <key=uri>        Supply an input artifact by rd:// URI
                               (repeatable) (default: [])
  --artifacts-json <key=json>  Supply input artifacts as a JSON array of rd://
                               URIs (repeatable) (default: [])
```

### `rundown pass`

```text
Usage: rundown pass|yes [options]

Mark current step as passed (triggers PASS transition)

Options:
  --token <token>   Owner token of the run to mutate (owner_token from
                    runbook_started)
  --step <stepId>   Current step or substep position (required, e.g. 2 or 2.1)
  --index <number>  Current FOR loop iteration (requires --step)
  --text            Output as human-readable text
  -h, --help        display help for command
```

### `rundown fail`

```text
Usage: rundown fail|no [options]

Mark current step as failed (triggers FAIL transition)

Options:
  --token <token>   Owner token of the run to mutate (owner_token from
                    runbook_started)
  --step <stepId>   Current step or substep position (required, e.g. 2 or 2.1)
  --index <number>  Current FOR loop iteration (requires --step)
  --text            Output as human-readable text
  -h, --help        display help for command
```

### `rundown goto`

```text
Usage: rundown goto [options] <step>

Jump to specific step (e.g., "3" or "3.1" for substep)

Options:
  --index <number>  FOR loop iteration to target
  --token <token>   Owner token of the run to mutate (owner_token from
                    runbook_started)
  --text            Output as human-readable text
  -h, --help        display help for command
```

### `rundown status`

```text
Usage: rundown status [options]

Show run state (all runs, or one run with --run)

Options:
  --run <runId>            Show one run in detail
  --claimed-by <agent-id>  List the delegated children this agent claimed that
                           are still running and counted
  --text                   Output as human-readable text
  -h, --help               display help for command
```

### `rundown stop`

```text
Usage: rundown stop [options] [message]

Abort a running runbook

Arguments:
  message          Stop message

Options:
  --token <token>  Owner token of the run to mutate (owner_token from
                   runbook_started)
  --run <runId>    Human escape hatch for a lost owner token: stop this
                   top-level run by id after confirming at an interactive
                   terminal (audited; never for agents)
  --text           Output as human-readable text
  -h, --help       display help for command
```

### `rundown claim`

```text
Usage: rundown claim [options] <ticket>

Claim a delegated child by its Claim Ticket and start it (prints its owner
token)

Options:
  --agent-id <id>  Identity of the claiming agent, recorded on the child
  --text           Output as human-readable text
  -h, --help       display help for command
```

### `rundown collect`

```text
Usage: rundown collect [options]

Collect the results of the run's current delegated children

Options:
  --token <token>  Owner token of the run to mutate (owner_token from
                   runbook_started)
  --text           Output as human-readable text
  -h, --help       display help for command
```

### `rundown retry`

```text
Usage: rundown retry [options]

Cancel a delegated child and reserve a fresh one with a new claim ticket

Options:
  --token <token>   Owner token of the run to mutate (owner_token from
                    runbook_started)
  --step <stepId>   The delegated substep to retry (required, e.g. 2.1)
  --index <number>  Current FOR loop iteration (requires --step)
  --text            Output as human-readable text
  -h, --help        display help for command
```

### `rundown release`

```text
Usage: rundown release [options] <child-id>

Abandon a delegated child you claimed but cannot finish (collected as a fail)

Options:
  --agent-id <id>  Identity of the releasing agent; must match the claim
  --text           Output as human-readable text
  -h, --help       display help for command
```

### `rundown prune`

```text
Usage: rundown prune [options]

Remove run state (does not delete runbook files)

Options:
  --token <token>  Owner token of the run to mutate (owner_token from
                   runbook_started); deletes that one running run
  --dry-run        Show what would be removed without deleting
  --completed      Prune successfully completed run state
  --stopped        Prune stopped (aborted/failed) run state
  --active         Prune running run state (each needs its --token, or your
                   confirmation at a terminal)
  --inactive       Prune invalid or abandoned run state
  --all            Prune all run state
  --text           Output as human-readable text
  -h, --help       display help for command
```

### `rundown scenario`

```text
Usage: rundown scenario [options] [command]

List, show, or run scenarios from a runbook

Options:
  -h, --help                    display help for command

Commands:
  ls [options] <file>           List all scenarios in a runbook
  show [options] <file> <name>  Show details for a specific scenario
  run [options] <file> <name>   Execute a scenario and verify the result
  help [command]                display help for command
```


### `rundown scenario-suite`

```text
Usage: rundown scenario-suite [options] [command]

List, show, or run cases from a scenario suite file

Options:
  -h, --help                          display help for command

Commands:
  ls [options] <suite-file>           List all cases in a scenario suite
  show [options] <suite-file> <case>  Show details for a specific case in a
                                      suite
  run [options] <suite-file> [case]   Execute a case (or all cases with --all)
                                      from a suite
  help [command]                      display help for command
```

```text
Usage: rundown scenario-suite ls [options] <suite-file>
```


#### `rundown scenario-suite run`

```text
Usage: rundown scenario-suite run [options] <suite-file> [case]

Execute a case (or all cases with --all) from a suite

Options:

  --text       Output as human-readable text
```
